meta.homeDescription: Arthur Norat is a software developer who builds apps for Apple platforms with Swift and backends with Java and Spring Boot. Projects, open source work and contact.
meta.gsocDescription: Final evaluation of my Google Summer of Code 2025 project at VideoLAN: a Parental Control feature for the VLC iOS app, written in Swift.

hero.summary: I build apps for Apple platforms with Swift and backends with Java and Spring Boot.

descriptions.homeBudget: A household budget system for two people: a REST API in Java 21 and Spring Boot, with data in Firestore and hosted on Google Cloud Run, shared by an Angular web app and by native clients for macOS, iOS and Android. The macOS app is built with SwiftUI and MVVM, with typed errors and no external dependencies, and already has every feature of the web dashboard.
descriptions.menuBarTimer: A minimalist Pomodoro timer that lives in the macOS menu bar, with no Dock icon and no extra windows. A left click starts or pauses the session, and a right click opens the settings: interval lengths, rests, sound volume and launch at login.
descriptions.tipsy: A tip calculator for iOS: enter the bill, choose a tip of 0%, 10% or 20%, set how many people share it and see the amount per person.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: Google Summer of Code 2025 with VideoLAN. I designed and built a Parental Control feature for the VLC iOS app, protecting sensitive actions with a passcode or Face ID. It was also my first collaborative open source project.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I study Software Engineering at Estácio and work as a Judiciary Analyst, with a degree in Law. That background gave me analytical thinking, attention to detail and a strong sense of responsibility, and I apply them to every system I build, from the API to the app.

I build apps for Apple platforms, iOS and macOS, with Swift, and backends with Java and Spring Boot. In 2025 I took part in Google Summer of Code with VideoLAN, my first open source project. I'm based in São Paulo, Brazil.

contact.title: Get In Touch
contact.text: I'm always happy to talk about projects and opportunities. The quickest way to reach me is LinkedIn.
